steps.what: Participate in training or continuing education activities.

tasks.design: The {CALENDAR} shows the training or continuing education activity already scheduled. The engineering technician participates, to stay abreast of the engineering or industry advance. The schedule line is not attendance. A course with no id leaves the participation with the technician.
tasks.previous_blocker: A course was marked complete because it was on the calendar, and the technician had not attended.
tasks.enabler_now: The scheduled course can be opened. The participation still has to happen.
tasks.still_hard: An advance the course note does not cover still has to be learned in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The technician participates. The schedule is the booking already made.
tasks.altitude: Attendance stays with the technician. The calendar line is not the course.

reach.task: Run the course this technician actually attends.
reach.learn: A calendar line is not attendance.

evidence.claim: Opening a scheduled course is a lookup. It does not participate in the training.
Marking a calendar line complete is not continuing education.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.
Fields: The course id already scheduled. The screen does not mark the technician present. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the course on the calendar before attending.
unknowns: Whether engineering courses and industry courses share one calendar record.
research_questions: Who records that the technician attended, rather than only that the course was booked?

already_counted.description: Participating in the training stays with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop courses whose booking has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still participates in the training or continuing education activity. Only opening a course that was already scheduled is removed. A calendar line saves none of the attendance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored assembly note for this prototype.
Assemble electrical systems or prototypes with measuring instruments.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the assembly note already written. The engineering technician assembles the electrical system or prototype with hand tools or measuring instruments. The note does not hold the tool. An instrument that already displays a reading is not this time.
tasks.previous_blocker: A prototype was marked assembled because a note existed, and the parts were still on the bench.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored note can be opened. The assembly still belongs to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A fit the note does not describe still has to be made on the bench.
tasks.human_edge: The technician assembles the prototype. The note is the instruction already written.
tasks.altitude: Assembly stays with the technician. The stored note is only visible.

reach.task: Use a prototype this technician assembled.
reach.learn: An assembly note is not the prototype.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored assembly note is a lookup. It does not assemble a system or a prototype.
Time a measuring instrument already spends showing a reading is not the technician's assembly labour.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.
Fields: The note id already stored. The screen does not mark the prototype assembled. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the assembly note before using the tools.
A test station, drawing tool, controller, bill generator, or statistical program that already runs is not in these shares.
unknowns: Whether system assemblies and prototypes share one note.
research_questions: Who confirms the note matches the prototype on the bench?

already_counted.description: Assembling the system or prototype stays with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop notes whose prototype record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still assembles the electrical system or prototype with hand tools or measuring instruments. Only opening a note that was already written is removed. An instrument that already displays a reading saves none of that work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored electrical engineering criteria.
Review criteria and identify revisions, deletions, or amendments.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the existing electrical engineering criteria. The engineering technician reviews them and identifies the revisions, deletions, or amendments the outdated material needs. The stored text does not decide what is outdated. Only the amendment the technician accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A paragraph was deleted because it was old, and nobody had checked whether the criterion still applied.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored criteria can be opened. The review and the amendment still belong to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A criterion that is old but still required still has to be kept by the technician.
tasks.human_edge: The technician identifies the change. The stored text is not that decision.
tasks.altitude: The review stays with the technician. The amendment is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Use criteria this technician has accepted.
reach.learn: An old date is not a deletion.

evidence.claim: Opening stored criteria is a lookup. It does not identify a revision, a deletion, or an amendment.
Filing an amendment before the technician accepts that version would change a criterion nobody reviewed.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.
Fields: The criteria id and the text already stored. The amendment is not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the criteria before marking any text as outdated.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the engineering technician.
unknowns: Whether revisions, deletions, and amendments share one record type.
research_questions: Who confirms a criterion is outdated rather than only old?

already_counted.description: Reviewing the criteria and identifying the change stay with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop criteria whose standard record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: criteria id and the amendment the technician accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still reviews the existing electrical engineering criteria and still identifies the revisions, deletions, or amendments. Only opening criteria that were already stored, and filing the amendment already accepted, is removed. An old date saves none of that review.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored control installation instruction.
Install or maintain electrical control systems or programmable controllers.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the instruction already written for the control circuit, the variable speed drive, or the programmable controller. The engineering technician installs or maintains the electrical control system, the industrial automation, or the equipment. The instruction does not energize the circuit. A controller that already runs is not this time.
tasks.previous_blocker: A controller was marked installed because the instruction was on file, and the circuit had not been wired.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored instruction can be opened. The installation and the maintenance still belong to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A circuit the instruction does not match still has to be wired by the technician.
tasks.human_edge: The technician installs and maintains the system. The instruction is the note already written.
tasks.altitude: Installation and maintenance stay with the technician. The controller's own runtime is not this labour.

reach.task: Wire from an instruction this technician is still responsible for.
reach.learn: An instruction title is not the installation.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored instruction is a lookup. It does not install or maintain a control system, a drive, or a controller.
Energizing an electrical control circuit is not an automatic safety decision. The technician does the installation.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.

Fields: The instruction id already stored. The screen does not mark the system installed or energize the circuit. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the instruction before the installation.
A test station, drawing tool, controller, bill generator, or statistical program that already runs is not in these shares.
unknowns: Whether control circuits, drives, and programmable controllers share one instruction.
research_questions: Who confirms the instruction matches the panel now being installed?

already_counted.description: Installing and maintaining the control system stay with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop instructions whose panel record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still installs or maintains the electrical control system, the automation, the drive, or the programmable controller. Only opening an instruction that was already written is removed. A controller that already runs saves none of that work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The engineering technician still attends the training, still assembles the prototype, still decides which criteria change, and still installs the control system. A stored note can be opened. It does not do the work.
reach: Trainers run the course, and this job learns a schedule line is not attendance.
Electricians install from an instruction this technician is still responsible for following.
skills_to_grow: Attend the training. Do not treat a schedule line as attendance.
Change a criterion only after reading the material it would replace.
Install the control system by hand. A controller that already runs is not this labour.
role.ambitious_version: Training, assembly, criteria, and installation stay with the technician. Stored notes only show what was already written.
